items.title: Suno Faces Another Copyright Suit from Universal Music and Sony Music Despite Its Recent Licensing Deals: ‘v6 Is Not a Fresh Start; It Is the Fruit of the Same Poisoned Tree’
items.summary: Universal Music y Sony Music presentaron una nueva demanda contra Suno, alegando que la empresa entrenó su modelo con un gran número de grabaciones sonoras protegidas sin autorización. La acción se presentó en un tribunal federal de Massachusetts mientras continúa el proceso original.

items.title: Suno Blasts Latest UMG/Sony Lawsuit As ‘Fundamentally Flawed on Both the Facts and the Law’
items.summary: Universal Music Group y Sony Music presentaron una nueva demanda de derechos de autor contra Suno; la empresa respondió calificando la acción como fundamentalmente defectuosa tanto en hechos como en la legislación aplicable.

items.title: Musixmatch: ‘Lyrics are becoming the LLM of the music industry’
items.summary: Max Ciociola convirtió a Musixmatch en la mayor empresa de letras del mundo. Con el respaldo de TPG y un acuerdo con Suno para la herramienta de detección de derechos Sentinel, la compañía busca expandirse más allá de las letras.

items.title: Universal and Warner tell judge ‘new use’ clause in AFM agreement is “clear and unambiguous” and does not apply to their AI deals
items.summary: In June the American Federation Of Musicians sued Universal and Warner over their AI deals, insisting the majors should be sharing their AI money with the union’s members under its Sound Recording Labor Agreement. Both sides have made new court filings as the majors try to get the lawsuit dismissed

tip.title: Content ID no es lo mismo que ser dueño
tip.body: Que YouTube reclame un video a tu favor no prueba titularidad, y que no lo reclame no significa que puedas usar la obra. Content ID es un sistema privado de la plataforma, no una autoridad legal.

items.title: Suno Faces Another Copyright Suit from Universal Music and Sony Music Despite Its Recent Licensing Deals: ‘v6 Is Not a Fresh Start; It Is the Fruit of the Same Poisoned Tree’
items.summary: Universal Music and Sony Music filed another lawsuit against Suno, claiming the AI platform trained on a massive number of copyrighted sound recordings without permission. The complaint was lodged in a Massachusetts federal court while the original suit remains pending.

items.title: Suno Blasts Latest UMG/Sony Lawsuit As ‘Fundamentally Flawed on Both the Facts and the Law’
items.summary: Universal Music Group and Sony Music filed an additional copyright lawsuit against Suno, and the AI company responded that the suit is fundamentally flawed on both factual and legal grounds.

items.title: Musixmatch: ‘Lyrics are becoming the LLM of the music industry’
items.summary: Max Ciociola turned Musixmatch into the world’s largest lyrics company. Backed by TPG and partnered with Suno on a copyright‑detection tool called Sentinel, the firm is positioned to grow beyond its current lyric‑focused services.

tip.title: Content ID is not proof of ownership
tip.body: A YouTube claim in your favor doesn't prove you own the work, and the absence of a claim doesn't mean you're cleared. Content ID is a private platform system, not a legal authority.
